About this item
Exquisite Gift Set: This Women Glass Tea Coffee Pretty Cup Cute Mug makes the perfect gift for special occasions such as birthdays, Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, or Christmas. Ideal for mothers, girlfriends, and friends, this tea cup set includes a matching spoon, offering elegance and utility in one.
Elegant 3D Design: Our tea cup features a stunning 3D butterfly and flower design that elevates the drinking experience. The glass material is clear and smooth, reflecting the light beautifully, ensuring the cup never fades with time.
Complete Tea Set: The tea cup comes with a beautifully designed spoon that complements the mug's intricate 3D patterns. Together, they create the perfect set for stirring tea, coffee, or any favorite beverage, enhancing every sip with style.
Enhanced Safety and Eco-friendliness: Crafted from premium, eco-friendly glass, this Tea Cup with Spoon Set offers a healthier alternative to plastic. Although non-microwaveable, it remains lead-free, resistant to discoloration, and ensures that no odors or chemicals are retained, promoting a clean and healthy lifestyle for everyday use.
Versatile and Stylish: Whether it is hot tea, coffee, milk, juice, or even hot chocolate, this versatile Tea Cup with Spoon Set is perfect for all your beverage needs. Easy to clean and featuring a comfortable handle, this mug brings both charm and convenience to your everyday routine.

reviews_5s:
This tea glass cup is absolutely stunning! The delicate floral and butterfly design, accented with elegant gold trim, makes it feel so special and luxurious. It’s even more beautiful in person than in the pictures. I bought it as a Mother’s Day gift, and it was a huge hit—perfect for any tea lover who appreciates both beauty and function. It feels well-made and adds a touch of charm to every tea break. Highly recommended:)Got this for my mom for Mother’s Day and she absolutely LOVED IT!!! It is gorgeous!!
I’ve been trying to get the teapot for her as well but it’s been sold out for a while. Hope Amazon brings it back!It’s very pretty and elegant. It holds tea and coffee and any liquid perfectly. It’s a good size, quality is expected. The design is metal with gemstones.I bought this for my friend. It is packed great, and looks beautiful.A bit over the top, but nice. Could be a gift for a man or woman if they like coffee/tea. I found out from the vendor the reason these are marked as not microwaveable is because the handle is glued on. Take heed, as hot coffee and a disconnected handle is a true disaster. However I've put these in the microwave for 20 seconds or so with no issues except some arcing once. I'd recommend NOT putting these in the microwave. The paint apparently has metal in it. Be Safe and Have fun!Got it for my Grandma to drink her morning tea.
